description:
## Objective

Give the existing authoring corpus and Covenant checks stable commands.

## Context

Plan: `docs/plans/2026-11-03-1512-consolidated-quality-backpressure-plan.md`
Unit: `U2`
Covers: `R2, R3, R4, R9; KTD3, KTD4, KTD5.`

Implement only this quality-import unit. Follow the plan decisions. Do not change `lib/**` or `../refs/**`. When a source assertion needs a product change, record the asset as deferred with the failing command.

## Dependencies

- Blocked by: jido-07x.1 (U1) — Establish the quality source manifest and runners must be complete.
- Unblocks: jido-07x.5 (U5) — Port Action and Flow property checks must be complete; jido-07x.8 (U8) — Add the example catalog harness must be complete; jido-07x.12 (U12) — Port core basic and workflow examples must be complete; jido-07x.15 (U15) — Port offline AI examples must be complete; jido-07x.16 (U16) — Port core property, system, and peer checks must be complete.

## Files

Move `test/jido/core_authoring/**` to `test/authoring/**`. Change `mix.exs`, `test/quality/source_manifest.yml`, and `AGENTS.md`. Do not change `lib/**`.

## Instructions

1. Move the adapted authoring files without copying a second corpus.
2. Update support loading and ignored support paths.
3. Add `mix test.authoring` and `mix test.contracts`.
4. Add the two commands to the offline CI command.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The authoring test count does not change during the move.
- [ ] `mix test.authoring` runs all `:authoring` tests with seed `0`.
- [ ] `mix test.contracts` runs `mix covenant.check`.
- [ ] No `test/jido/core_authoring` duplicate remains.

## Verification

- `mix test.authoring`, `mix test.contracts`, and `mix reach.check --arch --smells` exit with status `0`.

## Handoff

In the Beadwork completion comment, list changed files, source manifest records, verification results, deferred assets, deviations from the plan, and remaining blockers.

comments.text: Completed 204362f. Changed AGENTS.md, mix.exs, test/quality/source_manifest.yml, and moved all 16 files from test/jido/core_authoring to test/authoring. Added test.contracts, added authoring and contracts to test.ci, and updated support ignore paths. Manifest record: split-core test/authoring remains ported and now targets test/authoring. Verification passed: mix test.authoring (74 passed, seed 0); mix test.contracts (3296 tests, 78 excluded, 323/323 active obligations); mix reach.check --arch --smells; mix format --check-formatted; manifest test (6 passed). Deferred assets: none. Deviation: the pre-move command mix test test/jido/core_authoring --include authoring --seed 0 exposed two stale Registry-to-Catalog expectations (72/74 passed). The moved tests now assert the current ArgumentError for an invalid Catalog, preserving and strengthening the rejection requirement without lib changes or skipped assertions. Remaining blockers: none. No lib or refs files changed.

title: Activate authoring and Covenant gates
